subject: Prophet x Redwood: LangChain/LlamaIndex SDK compatibility sprint?
messages:
From: Sara Kim <sara@prophet.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-10T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Prophet x Redwood: LangChain/LlamaIndex SDK compatibility sprint?

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the intro last week — our product team at Prophet.ai is excited about aligning on SDK and tracing compatibility with Redwood. We're seeing several customers ask for first-class LangChain and LlamaIndex support plus uniform tracing/telemetry so observability works the same whether they run on Redwood Hosted or self-managed.

High-level ask: can we run a short technical sprint (2-3 days) to validate:
- LangChain & LlamaIndex connectors work end-to-end with Redwood runtimes
- Trace propagation from SDK -> Redwood tracing (span names, resource tags)
- Prompt-tooling parity (structured prompts + function/tool calling)
- Performance sanity: token latency and basic throughput against a Prophet sample workload

We've attached a brief that outlines the integration surfaces (prophet-integration-brief.pdf). Would Redwood be open to a joint sprint the week of Nov 16? Our suggested core attendees: myself (product lead) and two engineers from integrations. We can provide a sandbox and temporary creds.

Thanks — keen to move quickly here.

Best,
Sara Kim
Head of Integrations, Prophet.ai

Attachment: prophet-integration-brief.pdf (PDF, 420KB)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kim <sara@prophet.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-11T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Prophet x Redwood: LangChain/LlamaIndex SDK compatibility sprint?

Hi Sara — this sounds great and aligned with our ecosystem priorities. We're happy to run a focused sprint. Suggested scope from Redwood:

1) Compatibility matrix validation: LangChain versions 0.1x/0.2x, LlamaIndex 0.8/0.9, common connectors
2) Tracing hooks: ensure span context flows through SDK -> runtime and that we emit standardized span attributes (model_id, sequence_len, customer_route)
3) Prompt tooling: ensure tool-calling semantics + structured output roundtrip (JSON schema enforcement)
4) Test harness: 10 synthetic prompts + 3 real-case prompts (sample dataset from Prophet)

I've looped in Marissa (partnerships) to coordinate logistics and Karthik (tracing/runtime) for instrumentation. We'll prepare a short compatibility checklist and a redwood-compat-checklist.xlsx to baseline tests.

Can you confirm sandbox access and whether Prophet needs any NDA/credentials process? We're available to kick off Nov 18 or Nov 19 (AM Pacific) for a 60–90 min sync.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-compat-checklist.xlsx (Excel, stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kim <sara@prophet.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-12T14:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Prophet x Redwood: LangChain/LlamaIndex SDK compatibility sprint?

Thanks both — quick logistics and success criteria from partnerships side:

Proposed sprint agenda (2 days):
- Day 0 (pre-sprint): share sandbox creds, list of test models, and sample prompts
- Day 1: run compatibility matrix and basic trace propagation tests; capture gaps
- Day 2: iterate on fix-forward approach, confirm tool-calling behavior, agree rollback/fallback patterns

Success criteria (must-haves):
- LangChain/LlamaIndex sample app completes 95% of test cases without SDK patching
- Tracing spans show model metadata and correlate to request IDs in Redwood Console
- No data-exfil issues in sandbox; PII scrubbed or synthetic data used

Requests from us:
- Sandbox URL + team creds (least privilege)
- A short list of sample prompts and expected outputs (3–5)
- Any internal constraint doc (rate limits, supported model sizes)

We can run the kickoff Nov 18 09:00 PT. If that works for you, I'll send a calendar invite and a short runbook.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Director, Partner Programs, Redwood Inference

---
Marissa notes: I'll own the follow-up if there are commercial asks after the pilot.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Sara Kim <sara@prophet.ai>
Date: 2026-11-13T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Prophet x Redwood: LangChain/LlamaIndex SDK compatibility sprint?

Quick technical details from runtime/tracing:

- We'll need the LangChain and LlamaIndex versions that Prophet recommends. If you have a requirements.txt or Pipfile for the sample app, please attach.
- For tracing: Redwood accepts OTLP spans; we can provide a short example of the span envelope we expect. Ideally Prophet will add a tiny shim to map their SDK spans to our canonical names (we can provide a one-file patch).
- Performance baseline: please indicate if Prophet expects GPU-backed models or CPU. For the sprint, a gpt-medium open model reproducer is fine.

I'll plan to allocate two engineers for the sprint afternoons (US PST overlap) and we'll instrument the tracing shim live. Would like to preseed a small script that runs 50 sequential prompt requests so we can capture latency distribution.

Jonas
Senior Software Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference

On a separate note, we should ensure any doc links are shareable; otherwise send ephemeral creds and a rotation plan.

From: Sara Kim <sara@prophet.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-14T16:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Prophet x Redwood: LangChain/LlamaIndex SDK compatibility sprint?

Thanks — Nov 18 09:00 PT works for us. Sharing the following now:
- Sandbox URL: https://app.prophet.ai/sandbox/teams/prophet-redwood (team access)
- Sandbox creds attached as prophet-sandbox-creds.txt (please rotate after sprint)
- Sample app requirements: attached minimal-requirements.txt (LangChain==0.21.0, LlamaIndex==0.9.3)
- DocuSign link for a short integration addendum: https://docusign.com/PROP-2026-94/kickoff

We'll scrub the samples for PII and provide the 5 prompts by EOD Nov 16. We don't need GPU for the initial run; CPU-based reproducible models are fine.

Looking forward to the kickoff. I'll accept Marissa's invite and add our two engineers to the calendar.

Best,
Sara Kim
Head of Integrations, Prophet.ai

Attachment: prophet-sandbox-creds.txt (TXT, stub); minimal-requirements.txt (TXT, stub)
